1  BEFORE  HONOURABLE MRS. JUSTICE MALASRI NANDI  ORDER Date : 26.07.2024 Heard Mr.B.P.Borah, learned counsel for the petitioner. Also heard Mr.R.J.Baruah, learned Additional Public Prosecutor, Assam appearing for the State respondent No.4. 
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that he would like to take fresh steps on respondent No.1. 
Prayer is allowed. 
Petitioner to take steps for service of notice on respondent No.1, 2 and 3 by registered post with A/D as well as by usual process. Steps within 5 days. 
List after 04(four) weeks. 
Interim order to continue.
